### `input.ghost` — Ghost Completion

Predicts the rest of what a person is typing and shows it as inline ghost text; Tab accepts.

**Why it exists.** Most typed text in business software is predictable; completion removes keystrokes without removing control.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `ghost` — Inline ghost text inside the field; Tab accepts. |
| Binds to | `Input`, `TextArea`, `Search` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |
| `label` | string | no |
| `context` | string | no |
| `examples` | list of string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `completion` | string |
| `confidence` | number |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.input("email").ai("input.ghost")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("input.ghost", {"text": "Thank", "label": "Reply"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "completion": " you for your time.",
  "confidence": 0.55
}
```

### `input.smart_paste` — Smart Paste

Distributes pasted unstructured text — a signature, an email, a listing — across the right form fields.

**Why it exists.** People copy details from one place to type them into another; the form should do the reading.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `fill` — Writes the resolved value (or several field values) into the form. |
| Binds to | `Form`, `SmartForm` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |
| `fields` | list of any | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `fields` | list of object {name, value, confidence} |
| `notes` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.form("profile").ai("input.smart_paste")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("input.smart_paste", {"text": "Ada Lovelace\nHead of Research at Analytical Engines Ltd\nada@analytical.io | +44 20 7946 0958", "fields": ["name", "email", "phone", "… 2 more"]})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "name",
      "value": "Ada Lovelace",
      "confidence": 0.8
    },
    {
      "name": "email",
      "value": "ada@analytical.io",
      "confidence": 0.97
    },
    {
      "name": "phone",
      "value": "+44 20 7946 0958",
      "confidence": 0.9
    },
    "… 2 more"
  ],
  "notes": null
}
```

### `input.semantic_validate` — Semantic Validation

Checks whether a value means what the field expects — a real job title, a plausible reason — not just its format.

**Why it exists.** Regex validation accepts “asdf” as a company name; meaning-level checks catch what patterns cannot.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `validate` — A coaching message under the field, updated on blur. |
| Binds to | `Input`, `TextArea` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | yes |
| `expectation` | string | yes |
| `label` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `ok` | boolean |
| `severity` | one of `info`, `warning`, `error` |
| `message` | string |
| `suggestion` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.input("email").ai("input.semantic_validate")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("input.semantic_validate", {"value": "asdf", "expectation": "company name", "label": "Company"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json

  "ok": false,
  "severity": "warning",

```

### `input.mask_synth` — Mask Synthesis

Infers an input mask, a validating pattern and a placeholder from a few example values.

**Why it exists.** Hand-written masks and regular expressions are error-prone; examples are easy to supply.

| | |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `mask` | string |
| `regex` | string |
| `placeholder` | string |

### `input.clarify` — Clarifying Micro-Question

**Why it exists.** Guessing silently causes data errors; rejecting causes friction; one tap resolves both.

| `options` | list of string | no |


### `input.sensitive_shield` — Sensitive Data Shield

Warns before submission when free text contains card numbers, credentials, national identifiers or other personal data.

**Why it exists.** Secrets pasted into a notes field end up in logs, exports and model prompts.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `validate` — A coaching message under the field, updated on blur. |
| Binds to | `TextArea`, `Input` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |
| `allow` | list of string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `safe` | boolean |
| `findings` | list of object {kind, excerpt} |
| `redacted` | string |
| `message` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text_area("notes").ai("input.sensitive_shield")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("input.sensitive_shield", {"text": "Card 4242 4242 4242 4242, key sk-abc123def456ghi789jkl"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "safe": false,
  "redacted": "Card ⟦CARD_1⟧, key ⟦SECRET_1⟧",
  "findings": [
    {
      "kind": "card",
      "excerpt": "424…42"
    },
    {
      "kind": "secret",
      "excerpt": "sk-…kl"
    }
  ],
  "message": "This contains card, secret. Remove it or confirm it is intended."
}
```

### `input.option_rank` — Option Ranking
